lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still, alien laboratory, crimson and violet light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for AALSuperweapon.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen AALSuperweapon-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish AALSuperweapon-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: monsters
images.prompt: Swarms of colossal space monsters in the dark between galaxies, far bigger than any fleet.

images.name: lab
images.prompt: A mysterious planet covered from pole to pole by a single ancient weapons laboratory complex.

images.name: agent
images.prompt: A fast armored agent in a crimson battlesuit, a one-person superweapon, standing in a dark corridor.

images.name: room
images.prompt: An armored warrior flying into a laboratory hall, firing four guns at once, explosions everywhere.

images.name: level
images.prompt: One sector of an alien laboratory complex, wrecked machinery and broken walls left behind after a fight.

images.name: complex
images.prompt: Endless halls and sectors of an alien laboratory planet stretching into the distance, many unexplored.

images.name: session
images.prompt: A sleek dark starship resting in orbit above a laboratory planet, its agent between missions.

images.name: flight
images.prompt: An armored warrior flying up a tall shaft, dashing past the walls, thrusters glowing.

images.name: carnage
images.prompt: Explosions, flying debris, sparks and wrecked robots tumbling through a laboratory hall.

images.name: nuke
images.prompt: A small nuclear blast flaring inside a laboratory hall, a shockwave throwing machines back.
